text: HOLD: we're keeping routing limited to the opt-in group while we fix two issues. Savings look solid at $76.56, or 36.0% against baseline. The gate failed because only 8 of 10 opt-in engineers passed every check, and we need 9. Engineers e08 and e22, both on claude_code, failed the router failures check (1.4% and 1.44% against a 0.5% limit) and the tool args check (0.73% and 0.79% against 0.5%). Next, we'll investigate the router failures and malformed tool arguments in their claude_code sessions, ship a fix, and rerun the gate with the same group. If everyone clears, we'll come back recommending WIDEN.
